description:
• Brand introduction: Classic Butterfly is a unique fashion brand that combines the timeless elegance of classic cars with the transformative beauty of butterflies. Our brand symbolizes growth, change, and the journey of moving forward in style. Whether you're on the road or embracing new life changes, Classic Butterfly is here to accompany you on your path with comfort and flair.


• Product description: We offer short sleeve t-shirts made from a premium blend of 50% cotton and 50% polyester. These tees are not just stylish but comfortable, and perfect for any occasion. Whether you're dressing up for a casual outing or just louning at home, our t-shirts are designed to provide relaxtion and ease, making them an essential part of your wardrobe.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): At Classic Butterfly, we believe in fashion with a purpose. Every purchase you make contributes $5 to the Chelsea Hutchison Foundation, a dedicated organization that raises awareness and provides support for individuals with epilepsy. By choosing Classic Butterfly, you're not only getting a high-quality, stylish product but also making a postive impact in the fight against epilepsy.

 
• Payment terms: We offer flexible payment options to make your shopping experience as smooth as possible. Payments can be made securely through major credit cards, PayPal, and other trusted paymen gateways. All transcations are processed with the highest level of security to ensure your information is protected. We also offer a 30- day return policy if you're not completely satisfied with your purchase.


• Other information: Classic Butterfly is more than just a clothing brand - it's a statement of individuality and compassion. We are committed to providing our customers with products that not only look great but also make a difference in the world. Join us in our mission to bring awareness to epilepsy and embrace the journey of growth and change with Classic Butterfly
name: Classic Butterfly
